subject: URGENT: Critical GCSS-Army Security Patch Required - Action Within 24 Hours
bodyPreview: ATTN: All GCSS-Army Users, A critical security vulnerability has been detected in GCSS-Army version 3.0. You must install this emergency patch immediately...

body.content:
ATTN: All GCSS-Army Users,

A critical security vulnerability has been detected in GCSS-Army version 3.0. You must install this emergency patch immediately to prevent unauthorized access to logistics data.

TO INSTALL PATCH:
1. Click this link to download: [SUSPICIOUS LINK]
2. Enter your CAC PIN when prompted
3. Provide GCSS-Army username and password
4. Allow installation to complete

FAILURE TO COMPLY WITHIN 24 HOURS WILL RESULT IN:
- Account suspension
- Loss of GCSS-Army access
- Security violation report to your chain of command

This is a mandatory update per Army Cyber Command directive.

GCSS-Army Security Operations Center
Do not reply to this email
